title: Control-plane HTTP client does not honor HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY

worker.report:
I set `Proxy: http.ProxyFromEnvironment` on the transport in `newTransport`. `NewTransport` and `NewDiscoveryTransport` now honor `HTTP_PROXY`, `HTTPS_PROXY` and `NO_PROXY`.

The new test passes. I never ran it against the old code, because I made the fix before the first run, so I haven't seen it fail there. The test checks that both transports pick up the proxy from `HTTPS_PROXY`; I didn't send a real request through a proxy. I ran only that test, and `gofmt` reports no formatting issues.

I didn't look at `internal/remotehelper/transport/proxy.go`, which the issue also mentions. It builds on the same helpers, so it should pick up the fix, but I haven't checked.

Test: `TestTransportsHonorProxyEnv`
Files changed: `internal/entireclient/httpclient/transport.go`, `internal/entireclient/httpclient/proxy_test.go` (new)
